company.description: Grizzly.fi is a decentralized finance platform that provides tools for managing crypto assets and yield farming across multiple blockchain networks. It offers automated investment strategies and portfolio tracking features for users participating in DeFi ecosystems. The platform focuses on simplifying access to staking, liquidity mining, and passive income opportunities in crypto markets.
